rip_frontier_clear_batch_effect = {
	every_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = rip_frontier_batch_step_@ROOT } clr_province_flag = rip_frontier_batch_step_@ROOT }
	clr_country_flag = rip_frontier_batch_started
}

rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = {
	random_province = {
	 limit = { rip_frontier_crimea_target = yes }
	 add_claim = ROOT
	 set_province_flag = rip_frontier_batch_step_@ROOT
	 ROOT = { set_country_flag = rip_frontier_batch_started change_variable = { which = rip_frontier_claims_issued value = 1 } }
	 log = "RIP_FRONTIER CLAIM crimea [Root.GetName] [This.GetName]"
	}
}
